cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I nodded when you nodded. Friday it is; I'll tell the committee they've accepted me as project lead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I nodded because Friday suits me. We weren't voting for a leader.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, scheduling first. Everyone's happy to follow my timetable, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'll vote against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, you'll be my finance watchdog. I'll put you first on the agenda for my meeting.
